result.rationale: best.html.erb contains `<%- end if %>` with no condition after the `if` modifier. ERB handlers (Erubis in this Rails 3-era app) emit each `<% %>` chunk followed by a newline/semicolon, producing code like `...; end if ` with nothing following, which is a Ruby SyntaxError. Compiling the template would raise at render time, breaking /embed/best for the topic-found path; the controller specs only assert response success via stubs and may not exercise view compilation, so this is a real defect visible in the diff. The mechanism is straightforward Ruby syntax: a trailing `if` modifier with no expre

judged_text: The `<%- end if %>` tag does not close the if/else — it emits the raw Ruby fragment `end if;` into the compiled template (the Erubis handler terminates `<% %>` chunks with a semicolon), which is a SyntaxError. Compiling best.html.erb raises ActionView::Template::Error, so every /embed/best request for an embed_url that already has a topic returns a 500 instead of the embed page; the new controller specs never compile views, so CI stays green while the feature is dead in production.
